title: Mixed Event — Paint What I Love♪ Rainbow Canvas

meta.Event: Paint What I Love♪ Rainbow Canvas
meta.Outline: Ena decides to go back to her former art class, but her teacher, Mr. Yukihira, tells her that her drawing lacks appeal. Meanwhile, Honami feels anxious about job shadowing, tasked with teaching a subject she struggles with...

rows.Line: Art class

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Layer the colors here to really bring out the texture and...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Okay, that should do it...
I've gotten this much done, so...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: You have five minutes.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Good...
I just have to do one last check and make some minor adjustments.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I made sure to fix the things that Mr. Yukihira pointed out last time, so this one should be...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Time's up.
Pencils down.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Let's have a look at what you've drawn.
First, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes, here...!

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
This texture is nice...
So is the layout.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: However, your vanishing point leaves much to be desired...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Also, the line you used for where the floor meets your motif is far too black. Please try to be more observant and think about how to better illustrate such elements next time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I understand...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (He's always such a harsh critic...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But he's also right...
I have to find a way to build off his criticism.)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Lastly, your most crucial mistake...

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: This drawing is unappealing as a whole.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...?
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Ena...
Are you still bothered by what Mr. Yukihira said today?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
I have no problem with technical comments since that's stuff I can fix.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But what did he mean by “unappealing”...?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: I think he meant that what you drew today was missing something. Like a spark of life...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
How do I say this...? Usually, Ena, your art seems to say, “Look at me!”
But today, that seemed to be missing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... Does that mean my layout wasn't that good? But he specifically praised me for that...

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Bye bye!
See you next time!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, isn't that the beginner art class?
It opened up just recently, right...?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Yes.
Children seem to really love it because of how nice and cheerful the teacher is.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Really...?
That's like the complete opposite of our class.

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: Hey, can I see what you drew today?!

rows.Speaker: Child
rows.Line: Sure! Let's show each other on the count of three!

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: It looks like they had fun.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Again, unlike certain other people who have to desperately hard to get a good sketch out...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, Futaba, wasn't that girl standing in front of the classroom last week?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Oh, maybe...
I remember her having this concerned expression on her face the last time I saw her.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Do you think she's interested in attending the art classes here?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: She seems unsure about actually going in...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (To be fair, drawing does take a lot out of you...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(“Beginner Art Class.
Open to all ages.”)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Would attending this class help me draw better?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What should I do...?
Two weeks earlier
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: That wraps up this explanation regarding your job shadowing. I'll be wishing you all the best.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: This is gonna be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Definitely! I'm going to a nursing home. What about you guys?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hoonaamii!
Let's do our best during our shadowing☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's! I'm really looking forward to seeing what it's like to be a kindergarten teacher.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me too!
We're gonna get to do so many wonderhoy things together♪

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Oh, Mochizuki, Otori, do you both have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I just received word from the kindergarten you'll be going to, and it turns out that they're going to be painting one of the walls. Their goal is to make it zoo-like by having various animals and such on it.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: In other words, they'd like to have both of you to teach the children how to paint.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! That sounds super fun!
Honami, we get to paint a zoo!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: P-Paint...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wh-Wh-What do I do...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was hoping that attending an art class would help me with my problem...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But if I turn out to be worse than a three-year-old... I'll probably end up becoming a laughing stock...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, look at the time, I need to head over to Ms. Yoisaki's house...
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, now I just need to let it stew for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I've finished making all the food I was asked to for today, but Ms. Yoisaki still seems to be working. I should take this opportunity to clean a little...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I cleaned the inside of the refrigerator just the other day, so today...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I thought moving my body around a bit would help me relax, but it doesn't seem to be working...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (What am I going to do about painting for that kindergarten? The children are probably going to be so disappointed if I don't draw something good for them...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ms. Mochizuki?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Eep!
Oh, Ms. Yoisaki, it's you... I thought you were still working...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm taking a short break. More importantly...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
You don't seem well.
Is everything okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...
I'm sorry for making you worry...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Don't mind me.
You've done a lot for me, so... I'd like to help in any way I can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ms. Yoisaki...
Thank you, I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Then, well...
If you don't mind listening...
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <K, Amia, I finished the illustration. Mind taking a look at it?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. Send it on over.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, this overall looks good. I have no issues with it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I've looked at it too!
I just sent you a list of suggestions♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Thanks, you two...
I'll work on making these adjustments.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <*Sigh*>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Enanan...? What's wrong?
Is something bothering you?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, just something regarding my art...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Your art?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So, the thing is...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <My teacher said that one of my pieces was “unappealing”. I can't get my head around what he meant since I thought I did a pretty good job.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I don't think he was talking about my technical skills either. I really don't understand what it is that I'm missing.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Unappealing...? I'm not sure I understand either...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hmm... I personally really like your art, Enanan, and find all your works appealing... But I guess professional artists see things pretty differently...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah...
Even when I think I've drawn something really good, he still manages to find all these faults.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <At the same time, I'm actually really glad that I started attending again...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's been a gradual process, but I'm finally getting my intuition back from when I was still studying properly. And I feel like I've been improving bit by bit.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I see. You certainly are doing your best.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, that's pretty cool!
And we'll always be rooting for you!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Thanks.
It may take a while, but I'm gonna become a lot better and draw illustrations that go much better with the music you all make, K. Just you wait.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, I'll be looking forward to that.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, speaking of art...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sorry, Enanan, but would you mind doing me a favor?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <A favor? Sure, of course... How can I help?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So, the housekeeper who I've been having come over is concerned about the way she draws.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She's supposed to do a shadowing at a kindergarten and has been asked to teach the children how to paint, but she doesn't have much confidence when it comes to art...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She wants to learn some tips and tricks that could help her improve, but this isn't exactly my area of expertise.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <She has to teach little kids how to paint even though she can't herself? That's pretty rough. Also, kids tend to just blurt out whatever's on their minds.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Exactly. Which is why I was hoping to give some advice that would help prevent that from happening...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Enanan, what sort of advice would you give her in this case?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What sort of advice...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hmm... That's kinda hard to say without seeing how she draws first. Only then will I know what's actually bothering her.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But this must be a huge problem for her if she's asking others for help like this.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I've never actually seen the way she draws either, but she seemed adamant about not being able to teach children based on her current level.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <And I want to give back to her somehow since she's been taking such good care of me...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'm not sure how much I'll be able to help, but I can try lending her a hand...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Wait, are you sure?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. You're always there to help me, K, so I want to do something to give back too.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Enanan...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Thank you. I really appreciate it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <However, I'm not exactly sure how we should go about doing this. Should I get a photo of her art from her and send that to you?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, you're busy enough as it is composing music, so I wouldn't mind if she just sent it directly to me.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, thank you...
I'll let her know to do just that.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Again, Enanan, I really appreciate it.
And I'm sure she's going to as well.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Hehe. Kanade sounds really happy. I'm glad...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm not sure I have the artistic skills necessary to teach someone else, but I want to do what I can to help...)
The next day

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, let's get to work again today right away and... Hm? I got a message...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Hello. My name is Honami Mochizuki. It's nice to meet you.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I apologize for messaging you so suddenly like this, but I decided to contact you after Ms. Yoisaki let me know how to reach you.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I'd also like to apologize in advance since I know this may end up taking quite a bit of your time, but this issue is weighing on me very heavily... I would really appreciate your help.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I see. So this is the girl Kanade was talking about.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And Kanade was right. She's so polite.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hello. I'm Ena Shinonome. It's nice to meet you too. I'm not what you'd call an art expert, but feel free to ask me anything. I'll answer whatever questions I can.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<Thank you very much.
I really appreciate you saying that.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <I'm very concerned about my artistic skills...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <My most pressing issue involves others not being able to recognize what I've drawn. No matter how hard I try.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Others not recognizing what she's drawn...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... So, she's struggling to draw what she really wants...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I'm gonna need to get a taste of what she's talking about before I give her any advice.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Would it be possible for you to send me a picture of one of your drawings? That should make it easier for me to give you effective advice.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
...
Hm...? No reply...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess I should give her a minute. She might be taking a picture of one of her drawings.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still no reply after thirty minutes...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It is getting pretty late. Maybe she fell asleep. I suppose we can pick this up...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, she replied!
What did she say...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<Apologies for the late reply...
It took some time for me to draw this.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Wait, she drew something from scratch?
Hehe. She really likes to do things right, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <It's supposed to be a dog... What do you think?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (A dog? Drawing a real one isn't easy, but if she's okay with something more cartoonish, I might be able to help...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wh-What is this...?!
This black blob... It looks like a sea cucumber!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, actually it's a little more complex...
Kind of like something's organs...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
She might have a talent for abstract art...
You could even interpret this as a metaphor for something else...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, she clearly stated that she's not confident in her drawing skills. There's no way she'd be able to do something so sophisticated...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
...
How do I respond to this...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I-I'll start by saying...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Thank you. I took a look at what you sent me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It definitely left an impression on me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm not sure what else to say...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<I'm sorry...
It must've come as a big surprise...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it did...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <As you can see, my drawing skills leave much to be desired...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <No matter how much I practice or try, I just can't seem to get any better...>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<So, Shinonome, please...
Can you teach me how to get better at art somehow?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: T-Teach her somehow...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<I know I'm asking a lot...
But I want to learn to draw! I want to be able to teach those kindergartners!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She seems like the hard-working type too...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But you usually spend only a day or so for a shadowing. I really don't think she has to go this far...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Maybe she likes doing what she can for others...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <How about I teach you in person?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Especially since taking pictures of what you draw and sending them over every time probably has its limits.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<You'd do that...?!
But I've already taken up so much of your time...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Don't worry about that.
I also stand to learn a lot by teaching someone else how to draw.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What do you say?
That is if you're okay with it.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<No, that'd be wonderful!
I'll gladly accept your help, Shinonome!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, that settles that.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But it's getting pretty late, so let's discuss when and where to meet some other time.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <Yes, thank you very much!!>
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I became a little worried after I'd heard about what I'll be doing during my shadowing... But I'm so glad that Shinonome agreed to help me...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm sure I'll do just fine as long as learn to draw something...or anything that's recognizable...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, we haven't decided on where to meet... Where's a good place for someone to teach me how to draw...?
Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Good morning, everyone.
Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oc-Oc-Octopus with squishy, little feet♪
A great, big sun having lots of fun☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What are you drawing, Emu?
You seem to be having quite a bit of fun.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Honami!
I'm drawing Mr. Octopus☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Mr. Octopus...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow, Emu, you draw so well!
Your drawing's so adorable too! I'm sure children would love it...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(*Sigh*
If only I could draw something like this...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Remember how we're supposed to teach those kindergartners how to paint?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I was actually a little worried about that since it's gonna be my first time teaching someone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I decided that I want to get better while I can by practicing☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (She's worried even though she can already draw something so adorable.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Honami, let's practice drawing together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: One of us can play the teacher and the other can be a kindergartner! That should make it easier for us to practice teaching someone else how to draw, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Oh, um... Yes, that sounds like a wonderful idea... Except...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That would involve me showing Emu my drawing. If she sees that...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry.
The truth is...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! I didn't know that you weren't very good at drawing, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, so... No matter how hard I try, I struggle to draw what I actually want... I've even been laughed at a few times as a result.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which is why I became worried after we were told that we'd be teaching kindergartners how to paint.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I had no idea...
That explains why you seemed a little down lately.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm so sorry, Emu. It's not that I don't want to show you what my art entails, but I'm very shy about drawing when others are around...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Fortunately, someone who does have some artistic skills has agreed to teach me how to become better, so I'm going to do my best to improve.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa, that's so cool!
When are you guys meeting?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This weekend... But we haven't decided where to actually meet yet. Unfortunately, we can't use my room because it's undergoing construction for the air conditioning...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I feel bad about asking to go over to their house, so I was looking for somewhere good for us to meet.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I see...
Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, can I join you guys for your art lesson?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, Emu, you want to join?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I want to practice drawing too, and I'd really like it if we could do it together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Plus, we could meet at my house!
We'll be able to draw all we want there☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, wait! That's if you and your teacher are okay with that, Honami...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm okay with that, so I'll ask my teacher... I'll be sure to ask Shinonome about this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!
Weekend

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... This can't be right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Based on the map Mochizuki sent me, Otori lives somewhere around here... But I'm not seeing anything that resembles a house...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: She looks familiar. Where have I seen her before...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I saw her when...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Crap...! Did she hear me?!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh... Do you happen to be, Shinonome...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, does that mean you're...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm Mochizuki.
The one who you'll be teaching to draw today...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
It was you that time, Mochizuki!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're the one who's been standing outside the door to that art class, right? I just happened to see you the other day.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Y-You saw me doing that...? Oh no...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She had such a worried expression on her face that time, but I guess that feeling's genuine...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That just means I need to help her as much as I can.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, allow me to reintroduce myself. I'm Ena Shinonome. You can call me Ena.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, right... My name is Honami Mochizuki. I'm hoping to learn a lot from you today...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: More importantly, where is this Otori person's house? I've been looking for ages but just can't seem to find it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
I believe this is her house.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...? This looks like the grounds of an art museum. I mean, look at this giant gate and fancy fence...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it says “Otori” on this placard...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What...?!
Y-You're right... It says, “Otori”...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You've gotta be kidding me...!
People who live in these kinds of palaces actually exist...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No wonder I was so confused. I knew that there weren't any art museums around here...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Haha... Emu's, I mean, Otori is well... From a very well-off family...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hold on. Well-off is putting it too lightly. I mean, if she lives in a house like this, she must be the heiress to a big corporation or something...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, Otori...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, that can't be.
There's no way she's related to the people who own and operate PXL...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... I believe she belongs to that very family. I'm just as startled since this is also my first time actually seeing where she lives...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?! She's actually an Otori?! As in the Otori Group?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes... I apologize for not mentioning it sooner... I was just so preoccupied with trying to become better at drawing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: N-No, that's totally fine. There was no reason for you to tell me. I'm just a bit surprised too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway... Shall we...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes...!
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You've gotta be kidding me...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: How many houses have a living room with a view of a gigantic garden...? This place feels more like a five-star hotel...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, that painting on the wall...
Isn't it Remidle's “Parade”?!
Don't tell me it's the original...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: S-So, this is her house...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Honami! Shinono-no-me!
Welcome☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm Emu Otori! It's super nice to meet you! I'm really looking forward to today's lesson☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Did you happen to be at Phoenix Wonderland with Asahina the other day...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Asahina...!
I hope you enjoy your visit to Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because this is a place that makes everyone smile!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Does that mean you're the junior she's been talking about? The one who performs in shows at PXL?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yes, that's me! Emu Otori!
I didn't realize that you were her friend!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, again, I'm really looking forward to learning from you today, Shinono-no-me!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm looking forward to teaching you too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Also, it's Shinonome.
Not Shinono-no-me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh no! I'm so sorry!
Shinonono...? Wait, Shinononmeme!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Haha... Why not just call me Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(She seems to have a few screws loose...
Is that specifically because she's an heiress...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (At the same time, I'm curious as to how Mafuyu interacts with this girl...)

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Oh, hello.
You must be Emu's friends. Thank you for coming over to visit today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
H-Hello.
Pardon the intrusion...!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. It's okay. You don't need to be so formal.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Feel free to relax and enjoy yourselves. I'll bring some snacks for you all later.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, let's head up to my room!
Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, let's start drawing.
Actually, before we do...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um, there's something I need to make sure of first. Honami, Emu, you're both supposed to teach the children at a kindergarten how to paint, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! I'd like to improve enough to make it so the animals I draw are recognizable to them...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Right.
Then, Honami, let's make that your primary goal.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh! Oh!
I wanna learn more about actually teaching kindergartners how to paint!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Teaching them how to paint...?
Hmm... First, Emu, I sort of need to know what kind of stuff you're able to draw...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, to start, I'll have you each draw something. After that, Honami, you'll focus on drawing one type of animal. Emu, we can try coming up with ideas for teaching children how to paint.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, I brought some art supplies along. Feel free to use whatever you like.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I got lots and lots of paint and colored pencils ready just for today too! Let's use everything we have!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I really wanna use this one since it's so pretty and sparkly!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, that is a nice color... Hold on...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I-Is this paint made from lapis lazuli...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You usually only get about half the amount of a normal tube, and you have to pay like around 50,000 yen...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What?!
Emu, why do you have something like that...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, this really big art supplies store had it, so I decided to get it because of its pretty color. I bought it using my allowance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So, let's use it all together!
We should be able to draw something really gorgeous with it☆

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
U-Use it?! Out of the question!
Not something this valuable...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? But I went through the trouble of buying. It seems like a waste to not use it...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that... No, that's not the point!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is watercolor we're talking about here. A pan at that too. Not only is it really difficult to use, you need to have the skill to match to paint effectively with it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really...?
So, we won't get to use it today?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um, well... I'll show you a good website with instructions on how to use it, so why don't you give it a go then?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...!
Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I thought she'd be sad, but she's smiling from ear to ear. She's definitely a bit strange, but seems really earnest...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now, take this paper and draw whatever you two would like. Ready?

rows.Speaker: Honami & Emu
rows.Line: Ready!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Humhumhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Alright, let's see how Emu's doing... Whoa, she's drawing to the edge of the paper. That's pretty bold of her...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(It looks like she's drawing a squirrel...
Oh, she's doing a good job with its tail. It looks nice and fluffy.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(It looks cute and cartoonish too.
I bet kindergartners would love seeing something like this.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I've gotta think that Emu's all set to go. On the other hand...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Sh-She's frozen up completely...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honami, how are you...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh? Y-Yes...!
I, uhh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sorry, I didn't mean to scare you.
I was just wondering how your drawing was coming along...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
I'm so sorry. I haven't gotten much done...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you still unsure about what you want to draw?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
Well... This may sound strange after asking you to teach me how to draw...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm incredibly shy about drawing in front of other people...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, because of how I draw... I was laughed at by some boys in my class during elementary school because of something I'd made for arts and crafts...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Luckily, some very good friends of mine stood up for me and told me that I shouldn't let what those boys said bother me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: However, after that incident, I started feeling incredibly uncomfortable drawing in front of other people... I became so afraid of being laughed at again...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That must've been so traumatic...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But I sorta get how she feels...
Seeing what you drew get torn to pieces by someone else is hard for anyone.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I mean, just look at me.
Being compared to other people and getting severely criticized doesn't exactly feel great...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's okay, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Very few people in this world are naturally talented artists. The rest of us have to learn and receive advice from others regarding how to draw.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I understand why you're scared. So, let's just take it one step at a time. None of us here are going to think less of you because of what you draw.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, she's right! I'll show what I draw too, so let's do our best together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(They're right...
There's no reason to feel shy here. Today's my chance to practice and get better...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-You're both right. I'm honestly still a little afraid of drawing, but I'll do my best. So, Ena, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Of course. I'm here to help.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. I'm glad that she has a positive outlook.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I mean, I was worried about teaching someone else how to draw, but this might actually go pretty...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll draw this part like this and...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (She's drawing the insides of something again...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, I shouldn't liken this to internal organs... How about...? Long rice cakes covered in red bean paste...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Hm? Hmm... The closer I look, the more I'm starting to think that she has some kind of unique talent...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I can't honestly tell what she's trying to draw... But it could look really interesting if she were to give it some more color and crop it...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, what am I saying? She said that little kids need to be able to recognize what she draws.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Which means I have to teach her so that anyone will be able immediately to see what she drew...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-I'm finished...!
H-How does it look...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmmmm...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Alright, first of all, I probably shouldn't straight-up ask what it is, so I need to word this carefully...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa, Honami, you drew a sea cucumber!
You did a really good job♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Emu, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... It's supposed to be an elephant...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Oh, she was trying to draw an elephant...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-It doesn't look like one, does it?
I'll try drawing it again and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, don't do that!
I really like your elephant!
So please don't erase it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...? But...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If you're gonna erase it, can I have it instead? I wanna hang it up in my room☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, Emu...
You're so kind...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Hehe. Nice follow-up there, Emu.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: As far as I can tell, Honami, you seem to have trouble visualizing the shapes that make up whatever it is that you want to draw.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Visualizing the shapes...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. For example, when you actually try drawing what you see in your head on paper, it's pretty common for it to turn out looking completely different to the real thing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Even good artists do that.
It's easy for someone to draw shadows a lot darker than they really should be.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! I didn't know that!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, let's start by really looking at your subject's features and doing your best to copy them!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really looking at my subject's features and copy it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But... I was actually told the very same thing a long time ago during an art class when we were sketching objects. I'm not sure I can...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, why don't we try something simpler?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We can look up some images online, print them out and have you draw their outlines on tracing paper. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, I should be able to handle that!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Great!
Let's try doing that!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (We have about half a day to work with...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (To be honest, I'm not sure how much I'll be able to teach her...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But she's trying so hard...
I really want to help her.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Okay, good...
She's tracing it just fine.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Honami seems to get nervous when she's told to draw whatever she likes. Meanwhile...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Humhumhum♪
Smiles all around♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's done!
Ena, can you take a look?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sure, let's see...
Oh, is this Phenny...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's really cute.
Are those balloons in his hands?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! He's going for a walk around Phoenix Wonderland and giving balloons to all of the visitors he meets☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
How's my drawing, Ena?!
Do you think children would smile when they see it?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I wouldn't worry. I bet your drawing can make anyone smile.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, but I'm supposed to teach and not just draw. I'm still not too sure how that's gonna go...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
You came here to learn more about teaching others.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... Well, you'll be teaching little kids, so showering them with praise first might be important.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Praising them?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. Looking for what they do well and complimenting them by saying things like, “Oh, that's so wonderful,” or, “You drew it so well,” could work.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And then gently give them some advice when you see something that you think they should fix.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Gently giving them advice...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um, so... I'm not very good at giving others advice...! Is there something I can do about that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm... Well...
How about we try practicing that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll draw something for you right now, so why don't you give me some advice regarding it?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ena, I've finished tracing it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Great!
Yeah, that's some nice tracing!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you!
I never imagined myself drawing these lines so well...!
I sort of can't believe it...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really glad.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If you can do this, then I think we can get you to pick a photo and draw exactly what's in it. Let's try it out!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was worried for a second there, but things seem to be working out pretty well.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(A lot of time's already passed.
I wonder how Honami's doing...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Whoa...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Sh-She's drawing another black blob!
Wh-Why...?!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: E-Ena...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wh-Why does this always happen...?
I was able to trace so well but this is...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That's what I want to know!!!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: G-Gimme a sec to think...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Hmm... She was doing fine just now. How did she go from that to this?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (There's nothing actually wrong with her style, so she could conceivably just stick with this and...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, that wouldn't help with her problem. That's not why she's here...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Am I just not cut out for this...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If this is the best I can do, maybe I should give up and be Emu's assistant instead...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (At this rate, Honami's never going to be able to draw the way she wants...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (To be fair, there have been times when I wanted to run because things got so hard...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But it's too much of a waste...
Art's supposed to be about having fun while drawing...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I need to teach Honami in a way that lets her do just that while building up her confidence. What's a nice, simple style that anyone can learn...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I got it.
Let's get you to memorize simple shapes so you can draw things more cartoonishly!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: In other words, you draw in a way that exaggerates a subject's most prominent features. For example, a cat has a round head with triangular ears...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Like this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's really cute...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: From what I've seen, Honami, you have no trouble drawing geometric shapes...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, wouldn't it be easier to break things down into their individual parts? A circle for its face, triangles for its ears, and so on and so forth...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-You're right...!
I'll give that a try!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A circle for its face... Triangles for its ears...! And I'll draw a couple of lines on each side of the circle...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I... I did it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's great!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, Emu, mind taking a look at what Honami drew for me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me?
Wow! Your cat's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
R-Really? You can tell that it's a cat?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup!
It's a kitty cat with a cute, round face☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Honami finally smiled.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Next, let's try drawing a bear!
A circle for its face and a pair of small circles for its ears... Like this, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... How's this?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, perfect! Nice job!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Th-Thank you very much!
I don't know what else to say!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Alright, let's keep this up and keep drawing more animals. Our next one will be...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I... I did it!
Which animal does this look like to you...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... A triangular face with triangular ears... It's a fox!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
C-Correct!
You got them all...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Good work, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This is the first time anyone's been able to guess what I drew...! I couldn't be happier!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And it's been a pleasure to teach you.
Hehe. You've made some huge strides since your first drawing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know. How about I keep your first one as a little souvenir?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wh-What?!
No, it's okay if you just tossed it...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I really like the way you draw, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I especially like the way you made your first drawing...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I kinda want to frame it and hang it up. Like the painting we have downstairs☆

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it has this really abstract feel, so it might actually look really nice in a frame.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We can hang it up next to Remidle's painting! Can you draw something for me?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: W-Wait, hanging my drawing up next to that Remidle painting doesn't seem like a good idea...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ena, Honami!
Thank you both for coming today!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thank you for inviting us.
Your shadowing's next weekend, right? I wish you both the best of luck.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, we really appreciate it.
I should be able to do just fine thanks to you, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We'll tell you all about what we drew afterwards!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
I'll be looking forward to hearing about that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Anyway, Emu, see you again at school.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup! Get home safe!
Bye bye!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Once again, thank you very much for today...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For teaching me how to draw, making my art easily recognizable and praising me the way you did... I really appreciate everything you did.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I'm really glad you're saying that since I can't exactly say that I'm good enough to be teaching...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I learned to have some confidence in my artistic skills. So, Ena, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. In that case, I'm really glad.
So, good luck with your shadowing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I'm this way. We'll have to part ways here. Again, Ena, thank you for today!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure thing. Bye bye.
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay...
A lot happened, but I somehow managed...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And they said that they're visiting that kindergarten next weekend... I really hope their shadowing goes well...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still, Honami's drawing really packed a punch. I don't think I'm ever going to forget what I saw...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Actually, I kinda want to take another look at it.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Yeah, this is really something else...
I can't make heads or tails of what she was trying to draw, but it feels compelling for some reason...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Wait, this drawing...
At first, I had no idea what this was...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I'm starting to see an elephant and its individual parts! Now I get it, Honami...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This must be its ears... Here's its nose... It probably wasn't intentional, but the way she drew everything is really interesting.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Oh, and here's its face...
Is it smiling...? I couldn't tell initially because of how this drawing looks overall...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Honami actually drew something nice, but her drawing quirks made that a bit hard to see...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I need to teach Honami in a way that lets her do just that while building up her confidence. What's a nice, simple style that anyone can learn...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: From what I've seen, Honami, you have no trouble drawing geometric shapes...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, wouldn't it be easier to break things down into their individual parts? A circle for its face, triangles for its ears, and so on and so forth...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I especially like the way you made your first drawing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Did the way I teach actually help...?
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, let's take a quick break...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay. Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, since we're going to take a break, mind if I take a space in the corner of the classroom...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Hm? Is that a sketchbook...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes.
I wanted to practice drawing for a bit...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Drawing? What for...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm supposed to go observe how teachers work at a kindergarten, and I'll be teaching the children how to paint.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hona's been practicing a lot lately!
Even at school during breaks between classes!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You saw me practicing...? That's a little embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's nothing to be embarrassed about. You're just trying to make the most of what you were taught.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You did say that you had someone teach you. How was that? Do you think you'll be able to draw some animals okay?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, yes... I can do this much now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Shiho
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hona, this is amazing!
Your cat, bear and fox look really good!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
You've really captured their individual characteristics.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You've come such a long way, Honami...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Way to go, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But are you sure about practicing here? There are plenty of other classrooms available if you'd like to focus more...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you, but I'd like to draw in front of as many of you as possible.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really?
Wouldn't it be better to draw somewhere that's quieter...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The person who taught me said that it'll be good practice to draw in the presence of others.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That person also helped me build confidence in my artistic skills. As a result, I feel far less shy about drawing when other people are around...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's nice...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, totally! Oh, I know...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Since we're on the subject, why don't we all draw together?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: All of us together?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We can all choose something to draw and show each other once we're done!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Something of our choosing...?
That sounds fun! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I'll pass.
Drawing together sounds like something kids would...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? Art is for people of all ages, is it not?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I suppose so...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then it's settled☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, everyone, let's do some drawing!!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Hehe. We're all drawing together. This is so nice.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Under normal circumstances, I would've had so much trouble drawing much of anything...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But thanks to Ena, I feel completely fine now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Anyway, we're supposed to draw whatever we like...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (So, I'll draw Shibao...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, KAITO, the ice cream you drew looks so real...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? It does...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Your little birdie's also really good, Luka! It looks like something out of an art textbook!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku, your cherry blossoms look beautiful. I might try copying you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I really like your drawing, MEIKO.
Especially how the drum's rims are shining.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm drawing a dog, so I'll do what Ena taught me. A circle for the face, ovals for the ears, fold them over a bit...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Shibao's a Shiba Inu, so his ears don't droop or fold over... Then, I'll draw triangles instead...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Huh?
Now he's starting to look like a cat.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (What do I do...? Shibao's ears are a little rounder. But if I make them more circular, he's going to turn into a bear...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Th-The more I try to remember his features, the less my drawing resembles him...!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Is everything okay, Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Eep...!
Oh, Len, it's you...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Are you having some trouble?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, um... No, I'm fine.
Can I ask what you're drawing, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me? I'm drawing my guitar.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh wow! That's incredible...!
You've done such a good job!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, she's right! It looks so cool!
Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hang on...
Your headstock doesn't taper that much, does it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, not really...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But we're allowed to draw whatever we want, so it doesn't have to be perfectly accurate, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I really love how my guitar sounds and I thought that if I gave it a pointier headstock, it feels like it could produce an even cooler sound.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're allowed to draw like that...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean, I don't know much about art and can't really say that I'm great at drawing like KAITO, but...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think you should just draw however you like. Isn't that what art's really all about?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm... Yeah, you're right!
This sort of design suits you more, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Right?
I know I could count on you to get it, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Just draw however I like...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(But if I do...
They won't be able to recognize what I've drawn...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How's it going, Honami? Are you finished?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, not quite! Just another moment...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have to make his ears rounder if I want him to look like a dog...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (What do I do in this case...?)
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Is everything okay, Ena?
It's like something's been on your mind all day...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: It's just... I feel like you haven't been able to focus on your art today...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That obvious, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, something is bugging me a bit. I spent some time the other day teaching somebody how to draw...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I'm wondering if the way I taught them was actually okay...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Oh, does that mean the person you were teaching couldn't quite improve...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, they improved...
But the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: In other words, Ena, you're worried that you may be suppressing the best qualities of her art, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I keep asking myself whether or not I taught her the right way...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Don't say that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Am I right in saying that you taught her in such a manner that she'll embrace drawing rather than pushing it away?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Also, I have to think that you lending her a hand the way you did is going to do wonders for her.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Futaba...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: I really don't think I deserve to be thanked...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: But her story reminded me of what I went through way back when...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Way back when?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: There was a time when I copied how other people were creating their work in order to become a better artist.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Like my favorite artists and people from art class... I tried copying everything that caught my attention.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: As time progressed, I got better, but began to lose interest in art... That was when Mr. Yukihira asked me...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: “Is this truly the art that you wished to make?”

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: That was when I decided to take a hard look at what I was drawing, and it led to me changing to my current style.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I didn't know that...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Yeah, and I think I mentioned this before. I also tried copying you, Ena. I wanted to make my art have the same feel as yours.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
But I couldn't figure out how...
Then, I realized how a person's art style belongs to them and them alone.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, me and me alone...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Yeah, she's right...
Only I can really draw in my style...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And only Honami can draw the way she does.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Which means, I...)
The day of the shadowing
Kindergarten

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line:
Okay, everyone!
Today, we have Ms. Honami Mochizuki and Ms. Emu Otori visiting us from Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy.

rows.Speaker: Kindergartners
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hellooo!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: H-Hello...!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: I'm hoping that we get to have lots of fun together today! So, Ms. Honami, Ms. Emu, if you don't mind introducing yourselves one at a time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
M-My name is Honami Mochizuki.
It's nice to meet all of you. I'm only here for a short amount of time, but I hope we can all be friends.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm Emu Otori!
I'm gonna do everything I can to have a really wonderhoy time with all of you today!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: Thank you for those lovely introductions♪ Now, it's our turn to greet our guests! Ready?

rows.Speaker: Kindergartners
rows.Line: Nice to meet you both!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: Yes, excellent job!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: Now, Ms. Honami, Ms. Emu, I'd like to start by having you get to know the children. And the best way to do that is to play with them!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: After that, we'll be painting the wall outside!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line:
So, everyone, let's try our best!
If things turn out well, people who pass by and see your art may even praise you!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Yeah! I can't wait to paint!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(This is it...!
I can't help but feel a little nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (However, I'm also aware that today is less about painting and more about having good interactions with all the children as a kindergarten teacher...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (So, I should do my best to get along with them!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, everyone, what shall we play first?

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: I wanna play tag!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, tag sounds great!
I'll be it first☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's see who's able to escape Ms. Emu!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: No! Run!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Stop right there!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Hehe. Emu's full of energy.
The children also seem to be enjoying themselves very much.)

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line:
Ms. Honami, I don't wanna play tag.
I wanna read this picture book.

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line:
Me too!
Ms. Honami, can you read it for us?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Of course.
Why don't we all form a circle so that we can all hear what happens?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'll get started.
A long, long time ago in a place far, far away...
Several tens of minutes later

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone!
Did you all get a chance to play with Ms. Honami and Ms. Emu?

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: Our next activity will be something that you all love very much. Drawing! Or in today's case, painting the wall to make it look like a zoo! So, let's do our best and paint us some wonderful animals!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartners
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's finally time...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I'll be fine...!
I just have to do what Ena taught me...!)

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line:
Hey, Ms. Emu!
Let's draw some bunnies!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: I wanna draw a bear! Can you show me how, Ms. Emu?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course! Let's get painting right away by going brushy-brush-brush☆

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Wow, your bunny and bear are so cute!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Emu's gotten off to a good start.
Which means I also need to...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What shall we paint first?
Do you have any ideas?

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Hmm... A fox!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, a fox!
Let's paint some together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
We're painting foxes, so...
We can start with a triangle for its face, triangles for its ears and... Done!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's a fox!
That's so cool♪

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: I wanna paint one too!!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(...!
They recognized what I painted...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I asked Ena for her help...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(That girl is over there all alone.
Is something wrong?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hi there.
Would you like to join us for some painting?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Painting's boring...
And everyone always laughs at what I draw...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(I think I understand.
It's so easy to become scared of drawing after being laughed at just once...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Then, it's all the more reason for me to paint with her...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (If she paints something that everybody likes, she may stop disliking art...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see...
But I'd like to see what your drawing looks like, so why don't we try painting something together?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I'm okay with showing you, Ms. Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Is there a particular animal that you'd like to paint?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: A crocodile... Because they're cool.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(A crocodile...
Thank goodness. That's one I've practiced...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, let's paint some crocodiles!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Crocodiles have long jaws and bodies...
I can start by drawing a rectangular body...)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: All done!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, already?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yup! Look, Ms. Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
S-Sure.
Let's have a...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Huh? Is this a crocodile...?
I'm seeing a triangle pointed upwards joined to another one pointed downwards...)

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: What? You call that a crocodile?!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: You're so bad!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
N-No, I'm not...!
And it is so a crocodile!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Oh no...
What do I do...?!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (If this continues, she won't want to draw ever again...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... What you drew is very lovely, but you can draw a simpler-looking crocodile by...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Drawing rectangles for its jaws and body... Circles on top for its eyes and... There!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Whoa! That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: It's a crocodile!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: No, it's not...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: That's not a crocodile!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Hey, you're not supposed to talk to a teacher like that!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: After Ms. Honami drew a really good example too!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: But... But...!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line:
Okay, let's all just settle down...!
We're here to have fun and paint together!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(What do I do...?!
I just wanted her to have fun while painting... But I made her feel worse...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Also, why did she say that what I drew isn't a crocodile...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hm?
Why's everyone arguing?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is everything okay? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Emu...
I... I made a mistake and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, looks like everyone's hard at work painting...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hello, Honami.
I stopped by to see how you were doing.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And it seems that you ran into a bit of trouble...?

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line:
Oh?
Is she a friend of you two, Ms. Mochizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I see...
And she said that what you drew isn't a crocodile...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes...
I didn't know what to do after that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I thought that I needed to tell Honami first...)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it looks like I came at the perfect time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honami, can you show me the crocodile that girl drew?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, um... It's right here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This? Okay, now I understand...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hi, can you tell me more about your drawing...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I actually really like what you've painted!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: What are you talking about? It looks so bad...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
See? They're all saying how bad it is!
Lying to me isn't gonna make me feel better!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm not lying.
I mean...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
This is its mouth, right?
It's open wide like it's about to eat something.

rows.Speaker: Honami & Emu
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: You can tell?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yes. You did a nice job of painting a cool crocodile.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Well, if I'm gonna be honest...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Wait, this drawing...
At first, I had no idea what this was...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I'm starting to see an elephant and its individual parts! Now I get it, Honami...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This must be its ears... Here's its nose... It probably wasn't intentional, but the way she drew everything is really interesting.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Honami's drawing taught me that these sorts of art styles have their own unique qualities...)

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line:
A crocodile with its mouth wide open...?
Yeah, I guess so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know. It's a little scary, but your crocodile might look even cooler if it had some sharp, pointy teeth.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right!
I'll try painting some!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh, and... The one I saw at the zoo was eating this big block of meat!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. It sounds like you really enjoyed seeing that. So, let's try adding that in too!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Okay!
Teeth and meat...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow!
It really looks like a crocodile's mouth now!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: But you can't really tell that it's a crocodile just by looking at it! That means it's still bad!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Really? I think it's cool!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Next, let's try giving it some more color!
Which ones would you like to use?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Purple!
It looked kinda purply when it came out of the water!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sounds good! Then, let's paint it purple!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow... It's coming to life with each brushstroke...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think you should just draw however you like. Isn't that what art's really all about?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that's exactly right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Yeah...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Technical skills can help turn your ideas into art.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But what makes your art appealing to others is...)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
There!
My crocodile looks even cooler now!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That spark. The desire to express who you really are.)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Ms. Honami!
What do you think of my drawing?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You've painted a wonderful crocodile...!
And the meat it's having looks very yummy.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
It does?
Woohoo!!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Oh, Ms. Honami!
Did you see a cute crocodile like the one you drew?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I'm wondering because it looks so different from the one I saw.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I... I just drew my crocodile in a way that would be easily recognizable to others...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honami, mind drawing a crocodile for us? You know, how you normally would...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What?
But...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
Yes, some people might laugh at it because it doesn't look real...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I'm sure someone will understand as long as you try your best.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And...
I'm sorry for not realizing that sooner. That should've been the first thing I taught you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, that's completely fine...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I'll try drawing one!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...!
You can do it, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I remember seeing one when we went to a zoo for a field trip during elementary school. It was so scary...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It was scary, but I couldn't stop looking at it...)

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Whoa! What is this?!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line:
Haha!
It looks all funny.

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Ms. Honami, you were so good until just a second ago! What happened?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: O-Oh no... I knew this would...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: It's scary and really cool!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: It doesn't look like a crocodile, but it also kinda does!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! It looks like it's ready to attack at any moment!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Alright, this seems like a good time for me to exit since we're all happy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
Aren't you gonna paint something, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Me? But I'm not actually a part of this shadowing...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Let's paint something together!
I wanna see what your crocodile looks like!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line:
No, we don't need more crocodiles!
Paint a different animal!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Yeah, draw lots of animals for us!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...? U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: Would you mind joining us for some painting?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, but...

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks to you, the children seem to be really enjoying themselves and painting some wonderful animals. Plus, you're a friend of Ms. Mochizuki and Ms. Otori, no?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Ena...
Please, join us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The children and I would really love to keep painting with you!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I guess, what choice do I have...?
Especially if you're all willing to say that much...

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, done!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are these a pair of wolves...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I remember seeing them at a zoo a really long time ago. I also remember how scared my little brother was of them.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But they looked adorable to me, so I decided to draw a scary-looking one and a cute one.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...!
That's why they seem so different from each other!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Wow!
They look really funny together, but I really like it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Funny...?
You could've chosen a slightly nicer word...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
No, I really do like it!
Paint some more for us!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, let's keep painting!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Last but not least, let's paint in a sun and... All done!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Yay! It's like an amusement park for our animals!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow...
They look like they're having so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah.
So many animals painted in so many different styles...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's a masterpiece!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line:
Ms. Honami, Ms. Emu... And Ms. Ena.
Thank you all for joining us today!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: The children had a wonderful time painting thanks to you. We really appreciate what you did for us!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, no...!
I'm just glad that I could help.

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: You'll always be welcome here, so don't be strangers!

rows.Speaker: Attractive Kindergarten Teacher
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we have to say goodbye to our visitors now. Let's give them a nice send-off!

rows.Speaker: Kindergartner
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Come back soon!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Bye bye!
Let's draw together again!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: See you!
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you so much for what you did today, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We all had a wonderful time painting today thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, you were totally the reason why everybody was all smiles in the end! Thank you so very much!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. It was nothing, really.
I'm just happy that I could help out somehow.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, you did more than that...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My mind was so preoccupied with my inability to draw that I couldn't learn to enjoy what I create...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I finally was able to do a little bit today...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? That's great...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I should be the one thanking you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honami, you helped me realize what makes a piece of art appealing.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I did...?
It doesn't feel like I've done anything, but I'm glad to hear that I was able to help you somehow...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, Ena... There's something I'd like to ask you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? Ask me?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If possible, when you have some free time, would you mind teaching me how to draw again?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Today, when I was painting...
I actually had fun while doing it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm still not very good and don't feel entirely comfortable drawing in front of others...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I feel like I can really enjoy it if I learn to draw like you, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Honami...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I'd like that too!
I wanna draw with you two again☆

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'll let you know when I have some free time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know. If I'm gonna teach you to draw, why don't we do sketches like a real class?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
S-Sketches...?!
That sounds kind of difficult... But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd like to give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want us to draw something on a big canvas, so I can hang it up in my living room!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is turning into a big project all of a sudden...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it sounds like fun, so let's meet up again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Emu & Honami
rows.Line: Okay!
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow, I'm exhausted...
But I had a lot of fun today...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And everybody was having a ton of fun painting towards the end...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Today, when I was painting...
I actually had fun while doing it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm still not very good and don't feel entirely comfortable drawing in front of others...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I feel like I can really enjoy it if I learn to draw like you, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm glad I could help Honami learn the joy of drawing...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh no...!
I haven't touched that assignment that's due next week yet!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I've gotta get going on it...!
I have to fix everything that I was told last time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
No, I really do like it!
Paint some more for us!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe I should try drawing the wolves that I drew today. A little more seriously this time...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Huh...? My hand is moving without hesitation for some reason...
I've had so much on my mind lately...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm gonna keep going for a bit longer...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's done...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (My perspective's all messed up, and so are the details... I bet Mr. Yukihira's gonna have a field day with this one... But...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I like what I've made.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (My skills still need improving and I'm not able to express things exactly the way I want, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I'm gonna keep trying!
I'm gonna keep drawing until I feel satisfied!)
